# Accessibility Remediation Roadmap

## Purpose
Turns documented accessibility findings into a prioritized, testable remediation plan.

## Workflow
1. Use an authorized audit report and identify affected templates and components.
2. Map each finding to the relevant user barrier and applicable WCAG success criterion where evidence supports it.
3. Prioritize blockers, repeated component defects, and high-impact flows.
4. Define implementation options, owner placeholders, acceptance criteria, keyboard and screen-reader checks, and regression coverage.
5. Flag issues requiring specialist review.

## Output
Prioritized remediation backlog, component-level fix guidance, acceptance criteria, and retest matrix.

## Safety and limits
- Do not claim legal compliance or certification. Do not modify the live site or use automated scans as sole proof. No runtime activation or tool grants.
- Research, drafting, and planning only; execution requires a separate future approval and reviewed integration.

## Provenance
CEOAI-authored workflow. Intake candidate only.
